name: AcOpenDataMode
description: Specifies the data entry mode when opening a table, query, stored procedure, view, or user-defined function.

constants.name: acAdd
constants.description: The user can add new records but can't view or edit existing records.

constants.name: acEdit
constants.description: The user can view or edit existing records and add new records.

constants.name: acReadOnly
constants.description: The user can only view records.
